coverageRationale.zh: 把 IEEE 802.1AR-2018 写成可复述的设备身份链：IDevID 厂商证书、LDevID 域证书、IDevID 私钥注册证明、LDevID 证书链验证与“证书≠授权”的边界；不把证书绑定冒充访问控制。
coverageRationale.en: Turns IEEE 802.1AR-2018 into a reproducible device-identity chain: manufacturer IDevID, domain LDevID, IDevID-key enrollment proof, LDevID path validation and the “certificate ≠ authorization” boundary, without pretending binding is access control.

zh.principle: **标准**：安全设备标识（Secure Device Identity）。IEEE 802.1AR-2018 给网络设备定义 Secure Device Identifier（DevID）：一张绑定设备私钥的 X.509 证书。IDevID 由厂商在出厂时提供、全局唯一、防修改；LDevID 由本地管理员或域 CA 在设备入域时签发。DevID 的目标是让设备在没有用户登录的情况下，仍能用 EAP-TLS、BRSKI/EST 等协议证明“我是哪一台设备”。
zh.why: 设备身份的核心不是证书文件名，而是私钥持有证明。IDevID 私钥通常放在安全元件，不能导出；LDevID 必须绑定到同一设备的 IDevID，否则把 LDevID 拷到另一台设备就能冒充。绑定关系用 IDevID 证书指纹/公钥与注册证明维持；验证方还要验证 LDevID 到域信任锚的证书链和吊销状态。
zh.used: 典型流程：厂商烧录 IDevID 与私钥；设备入域时向注册商出示 IDevID 证书，用 IDevID 私钥签 nonce/域标识；域 CA 验证后签发 LDevID；后续 EAP-TLS 用 LDevID 做设备认证。证书字段按 RFC 5280；设备序列号、厂商、型号可放 subject 或 SAN otherName；2018 版新增 ECDSA P-384/SHA-384 套件以对齐 Suite B。
zh.broken: 常见错误包括：把证书当授权令牌；只验 LDevID 不验 IDevID 绑定；忽略吊销与时钟；把 IDevID 私钥当普通文件拷贝；把 802.1AR 当 EAP 本身。802.1AR 只定义身份与绑定，不定义业务角色、访问控制策略或具体 EAP 方法；这些由 802.1X、RADIUS/AAA、BRSKI 与本地策略完成。### 形式模型
zh.history:
IEEE 802.1AR-2018 于 2018-06-14 董事会批准、2018-08-02 发布，替代 802.1AR-2009；2018 版增加 ECDSA P-384/SHA-384 签名套件，并对 IDevID/LDevID 证书字段与供应商信息做细化。IEEE GET 计划提供免费标准 PDF；后续 802.1AReg 修订仍在推进，不能把草案当现行。

**技术参数与复算边界**

该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：安全设备标识的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 安全设备标识 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。

复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

**参数与状态规模**

公式 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\) 的输入、输出和单位必须逐项登记；复算顺序为：1. 读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数 2. 按标准表换算等效强度 3. 取最弱分量作为系统强度。

状态规模、密钥长度、分组长度和轮数决定复杂度；这些量不能从标题推断，必须以标准或实现文档为准。

**测试向量与实现边界**

标准测试向量只证明某组输入在某个实现中产生了预期输出，不证明所有参数都安全。记录测试向量时至少要写：算法/模式、密钥、明文或消息、随机数/IV、输出长度、实现版本。该条目已登记的限制是：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

en.principle: **Standard**: Secure Device Identity (安全设备标识). IEEE 802.1AR-2018 defines a Secure Device Identifier (DevID) for network devices: an X.509 certificate bound to a device private key. IDevID is manufacturer-provided at production, globally unique and protected from modification; LDevID is issued by a local administrator or domain CA when the device joins a domain. The goal is to let a device prove “which device I am” without a human login, using EAP-TLS, BRSKI/EST and similar protocols.
en.why:
Device identity is not a certificate filename but proof of private-key possession. The IDevID private key normally sits in a secure element and cannot be exported; LDevID must bind to the same device IDevID, otherwise copying an LDevID to another device would impersonate it.

The binding is maintained by the IDevID certificate fingerprint/public key and the enrollment proof; the verifier also checks the LDevID path to the domain trust anchor and revocation status.
en.used:
Typical flow: the manufacturer burns in IDevID and private key; at domain join the device presents the IDevID certificate and signs a nonce/domain ID with the IDevID key; the domain CA verifies and issues LDevID; later EAP-TLS uses LDevID for device authentication.

Certificate fields follow RFC 5280; serial, vendor and model can sit in subject or SAN otherName; the 2018 revision adds the ECDSA P-384/SHA-384 suite for Suite B alignment.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken:
Common errors include treating a certificate as an authorization token, validating LDevID without the IDevID binding, ignoring revocation and time, copying the IDevID private key like a normal file, or treating 802.1AR as EAP itself.

802.1AR defines identity and binding only; business roles, access policy and the EAP method are supplied by 802.1X, RADIUS/AAA, BRSKI and local policy.

en.history:
IEEE 802.1AR-2018 was approved by the IEEE SA Board on 2018-06-14 and published on 2018-08-02, superseding 802.1AR-2009. The 2018 revision adds the ECDSA P-384/SHA-384 signature suite and refines IDevID/LDevID certificate fields and supplier information.

The IEEE GET program provides a free standard PDF; the later 802.1AReg amendment is still in progress and must not be treated as current text.
